purpose: Reference scaffolding for Enterprise Security notable/correlation UCs. Extracted from NIS2 domain-pack patterns. Authors adapt per UC.

ta.name: Splunk Enterprise Security
ta.scope: Premium app on Search Head; `notable` macro / incident_review KV store

kfps.scenario: Active major incident — analysts leave notables open while triaging underlying campaign.
kfps.distinguish: Parent risk object with elevated risk_score in index=risk; open ServiceNow MAJ ticket.
kfps.suppress: Notable Event Suppression for campaign duration in ES Configure > Incident Management.

kfps.scenario: Correlation rule tuning — bulk recategorisation leaves notables temporarily open.
kfps.distinguish: lastModified on correlation search in Content Management within 7 days.
kfps.suppress: Time-bound exception in regulation-specific register keyed on rule_name.

kfps.scenario: Risk-Based Alerting consolidates individual rule fires into aggregate informational notables.
kfps.distinguish: Per-rule notable missing but index=risk shows recent contributions.
kfps.suppress: Pivot SPL to risk-aggregated evidence; do not count informational urgency toward SLA.

kfps.scenario: Holiday staffing gap — no analyst on shift to acknowledge aged notables.
kfps.distinguish: PagerDuty/on-call schedule shows unacknowledged page for same rule_name.
kfps.suppress: Escalate on-call; aged notable is valid IR metric — do not globally suppress rule.

troubleshooting.cause: ES not on search head or missing index=notable read permission
troubleshooting.fix: | rest /services/apps/local | search title=SplunkEnterpriseSecuritySuite; grant index=notable read
